title: Uninstall a Python application installed with pipx
summary: Remove a Python application that was previously installed using pipx. This deletes the isolated virtual environment associated with the app.

aliases.text: delete python app installed by pipx

steps.explain: Uninstall the specified package and remove its virtual environment.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: The name of the Python package to uninstall

steps.expect: A confirmation message that the package has been uninstalled.
